subject: Short notice: consolidate two brief sessions into one demo block
messages:
From: Sam Lutz <sam.lutz@bluecart.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Quick ask — can we combine two short sessions?

Hi Irene / Naomi,

Thanks again for setting up the two 20-minute sessions tomorrow (intro + hands-on). A couple of our stakeholders just pushed for a compressed schedule and asked whether we can combine the two into a single 40-minute block to make it easier for the team.

Totally understand this is short notice. If it helps, we can be flexible on the start time between 10:00–13:00 PT. Would that be possible on your side?

If combining isn't workable, we can keep two separate slots but might need to shift one later in the day.

Appreciate the quick read — Sam
BlueCart — Product Ops

Attachment: BlueCart-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 42KB)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lutz <sam.lutz@bluecart.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we combine two short sessions?

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up.

On short notice we can try to merge the two into a single 40-minute block, but two notes:
- Marcus (our SE) is traveling and has a 30-minute window earlier in the day (11:00–11:30 PT) when he can join in person; outside that he can dial in but prefers not to present from mobile.
- Naomi (CS) can own the hands-on portion if Marcus needs to step out for the last 10 minutes.

Proposed plan: hold a consolidated 40-minute session at 11:00 PT. Marcus will join live for the first 30 minutes; Naomi will take the final segment and cover the implementation checklist. If that works for BlueCart, I'll update the calendar and drop a single agenda (attached).

If you prefer a fully SE-led session, we can keep the two slots and move the second to 14:00 PT — but that would be tomorrow afternoon.

Options (all PT):
- Consolidated: 11:00–11:40 (preferred)
- Split, SE-led: 10:00–10:20 and 14:00–14:20

Let me know which you prefer and I'll send a calendar update.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we combine two short sessions?

Irene / Naomi — quick note: I'm on a flight that lands at 10:50 PT, customs expected ~11:10. I can absolutely join 11:00 PT but will likely be on my phone until we land; not ideal for screen-share. If we lock 11:00, I'll join early and hand off to Naomi for the deep CLI walkthrough at ~11:25.

If BlueCart strongly prefers a single presenter for the whole time, I'd recommend Naomi run the consolidated session and I'll follow up with a recorded snippet of the setup commands and a short live Q&A at 14:00 PT (10–15 minutes).

TL;DR: I can make 11:00 with a partial presence; Naomi can cover end-to-end if you want a single steady presenter.

—Marcus
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Sam Lutz <sam.lutz@bluecart.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we combine two short sessions?

Thanks all — appreciate the quick coordination. The team prefers a single consistent presenter, so let's have Naomi run the consolidated 40-minute session at 11:00–11:40 PT and Marcus do the short follow-up Q&A at 14:00 PT if any deep technical questions come up.

Irene — can you send the updated invite and the combined agenda? We'll accept once updated.

Sam
Product Ops, BlueCart

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=bluecart-demo-20270616 (Sam will accept after invite update)
